'''Rockhog''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Mudrump]] at 5 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "In desperate attempts to dodge Rockhog's filthy mud balls, unlucky opponents have been forced to master the art of side-stepping. From a distance. it almost looks like everyone is swaying along to the beat."

Rockhog is an early game, purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Rockhog is a large brown boar. It has long tusks sprouting from its face, hypnotic pink eyes, and a mullet-like hairstyle that extends to its rear. It has a typical pig nose and tail, dark brown hooves, and mid-tone brown spots on its side resembling a natural rocky armor. 

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Pink eyes mean Rockhog is hypnotized. Wake it up and you'll have a hog fight on your hands."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Covered in rock-solid skin and armed with long sharp teeth. When enraged, Rockhog enters a state of fury as signaled by the reddening of the eyes."

==Strategy==
[[File:Rockhog Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Rockhog's attack range]]
Best to partner up with Tataris that do AoE damage to get the best use of its slow effect.
